columns.authors_clean: List of resolved human author strings (agencies and initials excluded)
columns.author_count: Number of human authors credited on the article
columns.has_agency: Boolean flag indicating whether a wire agency was credited
columns.shares: Integer count of user article shares (snapshot)
columns.kommentare: Integer count of approved user comments (snapshot)
columns.kommentare_erlaubt: Boolean flag indicating whether comments were enabled
columns.clean_terms_list: List of lowercase lemmatized noun keywords extracted via spaCy
